data.one_liner: Paystack Flutter plugin for accepting card and MPesa payments on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter apps to initialize the Paystack SDK and launch native payment flows for processing customer transactions. Supports multiple channels including cards and MPesa depending on the platform.
use_when: You need to accept payments using Paystack in your Flutter app.
Your target platforms are Android and iOS.
avoid_when: You need support for web, desktop, or macOS.
You require an alternative payment gateway like Stripe or Adyen.
strengths: Native view support for both Android and iOS.
Supports multiple payment channels like cards and MPesa.
weaknesses: Requires manual Android setup to change FlutterActivity to FlutterFragmentActivity.
data.setup_notes: Requires Android SDK minimum 23, Compile SDK 34, and changing FlutterActivity to FlutterFragmentActivity in the Android MainActivity.

alternatives.name: flutter_stripe
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you prefer Stripe over Paystack for processing payments.

alternatives.name: adyen_checkout
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you want to use Adyen instead of Paystack for payment processing.
